title: Lakshmi Ashtottara Shatanamavali Meaning: Names 25-28 (Vasudharini, Kamala, Kanta, Kamakshi)
desc: Meaning of Goddess Lakshmi's 108 names, numbers 25 to 28: Vasudharini, Kamala, Kanta, Kamakshi, with a short note on each.
alt: Goddess Lakshmi, 108 names 25 to 28 with meaning
caption: Names 25 to 28 of the 108 names of Lakshmi.
intro: The **108 names of Goddess Lakshmi (Ashtottara Shatanamavali)** are chanted on Fridays and at Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham. This post explains **names 25 to 28**: **Vasudharini, Kamala, Kanta, Kamakshi**.
takeaways: Each name describes one quality of Lakshmi: Vasudharini, Kamala, Kanta, Kamakshi.
Fridays are the traditional day for Lakshmi names.
Say each name with 'Om' before and 'Namah' after.

p: **Vasudharini** means **Bearer of wealth**. She holds the treasure of the world and shares it with the worthy.
**Kamala** means **The Lotus Goddess**. Kamala is a very common name of Lakshmi, from the lotus she stands on.
**Kanta** means **The Beloved**. Beloved of Vishnu and dear to her devotees.
**Kamakshi** means **Wish-fulfilling eyes**. Kama-akshi: the one whose gracious glance fulfils wishes.
Offer flowers or kumkum at each name if you can, saying 'Om', the name, then 'Namah'. If time is short, chant a few names a day and complete the 108 over the week.

faq.q: How many names does Lakshmi Ashtottara have?
faq.a: **108** names, which is why it is called Ashtottara Shatanamavali.

faq.q: Which day is best for Lakshmi names?
faq.a: **Friday**, and festival days like Diwali and Varalakshmi Vratham.
